curriculumTitle: Natural Disasters: Science, Engineering, and Policy
description: Exploring natural hazards, engineering mitigation strategies, and policy decisions to protect communities through interdisciplinary perspectives.
courseDescription: An elective course exploring natural disasters through the lens of science, engineering, and policy perspectives

units.description: Understanding seismic activity, plate tectonics, and earthquake engineering from scientist, engineer, and policymaker perspectives.
units.coreIdea: Earth's internal processes drive seismic activity that poses risks to human communities
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Major earthquake events and their societal impacts

chapters.description: Investigating the scientific mechanisms behind earthquakes
Developing policies for earthquake preparedness and response

units.unitName: Severe Weather - When the Sky Attacks
units.description: Analyzing atmospheric phenomena, weather prediction, and storm mitigation through multiple disciplinary lenses.
units.coreIdea: Atmospheric systems create severe weather events requiring scientific understanding, engineering solutions, and policy responses
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Severe weather events and their community impacts

chapters.description: Understanding weather systems and severe weather formation
Designing systems to predict, monitor, and mitigate severe weather
Creating policies for weather preparedness and emergency response

units.unitName: Fire and Water - Wildfires and Floods
units.description: Examining wildfire and flood dynamics, prevention strategies, and community resilience planning.
units.coreIdea: Water and fire create natural hazards that require integrated scientific, engineering, and policy approaches
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Wildfire and flood events affecting communities

chapters.description: Investigating the science of wildfires and flood dynamics
Engineering solutions for wildfire prevention and flood control
Policy frameworks for wildfire and flood risk management

units.description: Integrating scientific knowledge, engineering solutions, and policy frameworks to build resilient communities.
units.coreIdea: Resilient communities require integrated approaches combining science, engineering, and policy to prepare for and recover from natural disasters
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Community recovery and resilience-building after natural disasters

chapters.description: Scientific approaches to understanding community resilience
Policy frameworks for building community resilience

parts.partDescription: Understanding natural hazards through scientific investigation
Engineering solutions and policy responses to natural hazards
